SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch Station,
Date 15.11.32.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.I.D. REGISTER No. D.4153 Date 15.11.32.）

Subject (in full) "Society of New Education."

Made by Clerk Z.O. Zung. Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the extract from the French
Intelligence Report of October 28, 1932, on the subject of
"The Society of New Education" (File No.D.4153), I have to
report that individual inquiries made by C.D.S.s at 96 Foochow
Road and 96 Dung Wei Ling have failed to confirm the report
that the propaganda bureau of this society is located in a
certain bookstore at No. 95 Foochow Road.

The occupants of No.95 Foochow Road include the
following :-

1. The combined sales office of the New Moon (新月)
Bookstore and the "China Arts Publication Society".
2. The Joong Tsoong (群众) Bookstore.
3. The Kai Ming (开明) Bookstore.

The upper portion of the premises above the first
two mentioned stores is sublet to the Ching Dui (金台)
Lodging House, 94 Foochow Road.

The Society of New Education or any of its members
is unknown at the above mentioned bookstores or the Ching Dui
Lodging House, and a general observation kept at this address
failed to reveal anything suspicious.

（批：ok）

Zing Seong Den.
Clerk.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
（印：S.M.P. C.I.D. S.B.）

SPECIAL INQUIRY
MUNICIPAL
REGISTRAR
H.153
25.10.1932

TRANSLATION OF AN EXTRACT FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE
REPORT DATED OCTOBER 22, 1932.
----------------------------------------

Further information on the "Society of New Education."

We are informed that among the members of the Standing
Committee of the "Society of New Chinese Education"
(vide our report dated 9.7.32. p.4. para.8) are PAN HAN NIEN
(潘漢年), YAO VONG TSE (姚蓬子), HWA HAN (華漢)
CHIEN HEN TSENG (錢杏邨), etc..... was
The propaganda bureau of this Society is installed in
a Chinese bookshop situated at No. 25 Foochow Road.
It is to be recalled that the "Society of New Education"
was founded during last June by the Educational Committee
of the Chinese Communist Party, with the object of propa-
gating Communist ideas among the proletariat. This society
was actually controlled by the Public Instruction Committee
of the "Provisional Government of the Chinese Soviet Republic."
----------------------------------------

S2, Further inquiry and
report please.
Mr. Sims.
25.10.32
as indicated
and report. MR 29/10
